URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/bulletin/news/andy-burnham-cabinet-vat-energy-bills-b3018799.html
NOTE: The Independent bulletin (Tue 21 Jul 2026, 13:31 BST). Burnham chaired his FIRST CABINET MEETING Tuesday. He declared his administration a "cost-of-living government" and instructed ministers to identify ways their departments could ease financial pressure on households. Reaffirmed VAT removed from household electricity from 1 Oct. Chancellor John Healey said the VAT cut funded by cancelling the Digital ID programme. Starmer ally Darren Jones criticised the VAT cut as "unfunded" and called for clarification on financing. APPROVED SOURCE.
